description: Recompute AraM directionality using the measured B. subtilis G1P concentration
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
R=8.314e-3; T=310.15
Ka,Kb,Kp,Kq = 8.1e-6, 16e-6, 1370e-6, 59.3e-6         # AraM Km (PMID 18558723 via UniProt)
A,B,Q = 0.37e-3, 8.3e-5, 2.6e-3                        # DHAP, NADH, NAD+ (PMID 19561621)
# MEASURED B. subtilis glycerophosphate pool (PMID 35767906): total G3P+G1P ~30 uM, G3P:G1P = 4:1
G1P_meas = 30e-6/5
print("measured B. subtilis G1P = %.1f uM  =  %.4f x Km(G1P)  (%.0f-fold below Km)"%(G1P_meas*1e6, G1P_meas/Kp, Kp/G1P_meas))
rows=[]
for dG0 in [-16.9,-21.9,-26.9]:
    Keq=np.exp(-dG0/(R*T))
    rows.append(dict(dG0_kJmol=dG0, Keq=round(Keq,1),
        G1P_eq_mM=round(A*Keq/(Q/B)*1e3,1),
        fwd_over_rev_flux_at_measured_G1P=round(Keq*(A*B)/(G1P_meas*Q),0),
        dG_prime_kJmol=round(dG0+R*T*np.log((G1P_meas*Q)/(A*B)),2)))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); print("\n"+D.to_string(index=False)); D.to_csv("aram_directionality_measured_G1P.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,4.6))
cats=["DHAP\n370 uM","NADH\n83 uM","NAD+\n2600 uM","G1P\n6 uM\n(measured, B. subtilis)"]
ratio=[A/Ka, B/Kb, Q/Kq, G1P_meas/Kp]
cols=["#2f6f9f","#2f6f9f","#9f5a2f","#9f5a2f"]
ax.bar(range(4),ratio,color=cols)
ax.axhline(1,color="k",ls="--",lw=1); ax.text(3.3,1.15,"[S] = Km",fontsize=8)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(cats,fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("[metabolite] / Km  (log scale)")
for i,v in enumerate(ratio): ax.text(i, v*1.25, f"{v:.3g}x", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("AraM substrate saturation in vivo: forward substrates (blue) far above Km,\nthe reverse substrate G1P 228-fold below Km",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
